subject: BrightArc discovery — pricing & token volumes (recap + next steps)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightarc.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightArc discovery — pricing & token volumes (recap + next steps)

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on volumes, budget range, and the benchmarking you asked for.

Recap from our call:
- Primary use case: user-facing analytics assistant (short prompts + retrieval + structured outputs).
- Expected ramp: pilot (1–2 months) ~3M tokens/month; steady-state (6 months) ~35–45M tokens/month; long-term (12+ months) 100–150M tokens/month.
- Target commercial range: pilot budget ~$800–1,500/mo; longer-term monthly budget TBD but team indicated cost sensitivity and preference for single-digit to low-double-digit $/1M tokens if possible.
- Procurement window: BrightArc hopes to start pilot in April if terms/pricing align.

Requested from BrightArc (ask):
1) Confirm the three volume bands above (pilot / 6mo / long-term) and any seasonality.
2) Confirm target acceptable $/1M tokens for pilot and for scale. You mentioned you wanted a benchmark vs OpenAI/Anthropic — we can provide a side-by-side and explain tradeoffs (model parity, quantization, caching).
3) Any data residency / SLA must-haves? I heard US-only for now.

Attached: BrightArc_Reqs_and_Volumes.xlsx (volume worksheet + sample query length distribution). We will follow up with a short price benchmarking note against OpenAI/Anthropic and an initial Redwood proposal by end of day Friday.

Next steps proposed:
- Vanessa (sales) to send benchmark + proposal (this Friday).
- Liam to confirm volumes + procurement timeline.
- If budget/targets align, book procurement sync (procurement + legal) the week of 3/15.

Thanks — Vanessa
--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightArc_Reqs_and_Volumes.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightarc.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightArc Procurement <procurement@brightarc.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightArc discovery — pricing & token volumes (recap + next steps)

Thanks Vanessa — great recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volumes: pilot will be ~3M tokens/month (internal beta to ~200 power users). We expect a staged ramp: month 3–6 -> ~25–40M tokens/month (broader beta), and we model 120–150M/month as a realistic long-term number once product-market fit is solid.
- Budget: pilot bucket should be kept under $1.5k/mo. For scale, we have an internal working target of $40–$75 per 1M tokens; if we can get below $35/1M at higher volume tiers that would be compelling.
- SLA & data residency: US-only acceptable; we will need SOC2 evidence and a standard DPA (procurement will request).

Procurement timeline: procurement wants commercial terms and indicative pricing this week (to evaluate ROI vs current OpenAI invoices). They will escalate to legal if numbers look reasonable.

If Redwood can show a clear cost delta vs OpenAI/Anthropic at our target volumes (and outline where caching/quantization yields savings), we should be able to move to a pilot quickly.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor | Head of Product, BrightArc Analytics
liam.oconnor@brightarc.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightarc.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightArc discovery — pricing & token volumes (recap + next steps)

Liam — thanks for the clarity. Attaching a short benchmarking note and an initial proposal (pdf) with tiered pricing + pilot terms. Key highlights below (summary, not a final legal/contracted offer):

Redwood benchmark / indicative pricing (targeted; final depends on model selection & caching):
- Pilot tier (<=5M tokens/mo): $60 per 1M tokens (fits the pilot budget while covering base infra and support).
- Scale tier 1 (>=20M tokens/mo): $35 per 1M tokens + optional burst credits (for ramp months).
- Scale tier 2 (>=100M tokens/mo): $18 per 1M tokens (aggressive price enabled by dedicated pooling, quantization-friendly model variants, and KV prefix caching).

Comparative context vs common hosts (high-level):
- OpenAI/Anthropic retail-equivalent for comparable quality: typically ~ $90–120 / 1M tokens for the large general-purpose models (depends on model family).
- Open-model hosting (quantized, low-latency stack) on other hosts: ranges widely from ~$20–$50 / 1M depending on caching, hardware mix, and whether you accept lower-precision models.

Why Redwood can be more cost-effective at scale:
- Automatic KV prefix caching for repeated retrieval-heavy prompts (saves tokens and compute).
- Continuous batching and kernel selections tuned to your sequence-length distribution (we looked at your volume worksheet).
- Dedicated reserved pools at higher tiers to keep latency and unit cost low.

Attachments: Redwood_Proposal_BrightArc_v1.pdf (pricing tiers, SLO notes, pilot scope) and the workbook you sent annotated with expected token distribution and suggestions.

Ask from BrightArc to move forward:
1) Confirm pilot acceptance of $60/1M (or tell us maximum acceptable $/1M for pilot).
2) Confirm procurement timeline and procurement contact.
3) Any redlines on data residency / DPA items we should prepare for.

If you confirm pilot price, I’ll circulate a simple SOW + pilot order form and coordinate legal/procurement sync for the week of 3/15.

Thanks — Vanessa
--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Proposal_BrightArc_v1.pdf (proposal)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: BrightArc pricing ask + recommended commercial play

Sergio / Marissa / Monica — internal note before I mark final: BrightArc confirmed volumes and a pilot budget constraint. They gave a desirable target range of $40–$75 / 1M and said procurement needs an indicative commercial this week. My recommendation:

1) Offer the pilot at $60 / 1M (<=5M) with a firm 30-day pilot SOW and a one-time onboarding credit of $500 (to land under their $1.5k pilot budget).
2) For ramp months we propose Scale Tier 1 at $35 / 1M (>=20M) with committed 3-month minimum at that tier to protect economics.
3) If we want to be aggressive to win long-term business, include an optional Scale Tier 2 at $18 / 1M (>=100M) but require a 12-month committed contract and a quarterly review of quality/regression.
4) I will include comparative language vs OpenAI/Anthropic in the proposal (high-level ranges, not an exact price-matching statement) and highlight caching/quantization levers.

Questions for your input (quick):
- Sergio: ok to include the $500 onboarding credit? Approve or counter?
- Marissa: can CS support a pilot with dedicated onboarding hours (4 hours) for free? If so, I'll add to SOW.
- Monica: legal / procurement — can we fast-track a SOC2 attestation pointer and the DPA template so procurement can start review?

If you approve, I’ll send the proposal to Liam today and ask for procurement meeting windows next week.

Thanks — V
--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
